title: Ticket closure
description: A technician's verdict on a ticket, as POST /api/tickets/{id}/close records it. The verdict also travels inside the closed ticket message, so a consumer that follows tickets needs nothing else; this schema is what the API body and the app.ticket_closures row are validated against.

verdict.description: Whether the diagnosis on the ticket matched what the technician found.

note.description: What the technician found, in their own words.
